items.titleZh: 阿尼鲁单抗干扰素靶向治疗C1q缺乏所致单基因儿童系统性红斑狼疮：一例病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 继发于补体缺乏（包括由C1QA突变引起的C1Q缺乏）的单基因儿童系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种罕见且严重的SLE类型，其特征可为早发和难治性疾病。抑制干扰素通路已被证明是一种有效的治疗选择，尽管在单基因儿童SLE中的证据很少。我们描述了一名经基因验证患有C1Q缺乏的10岁女性，尽管接受了长期免疫抑制和生物治疗，她仍有持续且严重的皮肤黏膜疾病，表现为反复皮疹、溃疡和口腔溃疡。在一次疾病发作后，患者开始使用阿尼鲁单抗，一种针对I型干扰素受体的单克隆抗体。她表现出显著的临床改善，皮肤黏膜病变完全恢复，实验室参数恢复正常，并在第七次每月输注后成功停用皮质类固醇。该药耐受性良好，无严重副作用。该病例证明了阿尼鲁单抗在治疗与干扰素通路失调相关的单基因儿童SLE患儿难治性皮肤表现方面可能具有有效性和安全性。需要进一步研究来确定其在该人群中的作用。

items.title: Clinical and immunological features of rheumatoid arthritis patients with positive anti-centromere antibody: a case-control study.
items.abstract: To characterize the clinical and immunological features of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients with positive anti-centromere antibody (ACA). In this retrospective case-control study, the clinical manifestations, demographic data, and immunological test results of these patients were collected and analyzed. ACA-positive RA patients exhibited a significantly higher prevalence of Raynaud's phenomenon (15.0% vs. 2.5%, χ 2 = 4.838, P = 0.028), xerostomia (22.5% vs. 8.8%, χ 2 = 4.363, P = 0.037), xerophthalmia (27.5% vs. 10.0%, χ 2 = 6.128, P = 0.013), and interstitial pneumonia (27.5% vs. 5.0%, χ 2 = 12.343, P < 0.001), as well as higher rates of elevated ALP (18.9% vs. 1.3%, χ 2 = 9.780, P = 0.002) and GGT (33.33% vs. 15.0%, χ 2 = 5.086, P = 0.024). ACA-positive RA may present a unique phenotype characterized by an increased risk of interstitial lung disease, sicca symptoms, and cholestatic liver injury; thus, enhanced pulmonary/hepatic screening and tailored monitoring strategies are critical.

items.title: Case Report: A rare motor storm in lupus: opsoclonus-myoclonus-ataxia syndrome as an atypical presentation of severe systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: Opsoclonus-myoclonus-ataxia syndrome (OMAS) is a rare hyperkinetic movement disorder characterized by opsoclonus, generalized myoclonus, and cerebellar ataxia. In adults, OMAS is most often reported in paraneoplastic or postinfectious settings, whereas autoimmune etiologies are less common. A 21-year-old woman with a 7-month history of SLE developed a 3-week subacute OMAS phenotype with opsoclonus, generalized myoclonus, and gait/limb ataxia, leading to loss of independent ambulation. CSF, microbiological testing, and brain MRI were unremarkable, and initial malignancy screening was negative. Severe lupus activity was documented (SLEDAI-2 K 27). She received methylprednisolone pulses, plasmapheresis, and rituximab, with progressive neurological recovery and a decrease in lupus activity to SLEDAI-2 K 4. At discharge, she ambulated independently with mild residual gait ataxia. This case expands the spectrum of neuropsychiatric SLE by illustrating OMAS as a predominantly motor phenotype. A structured evaluation to exclude structural, infectious, and malignant etiologies is essential, and early escalation of immunotherapy may be associated with substantial neurological recovery when OMAS occurs in the context of severe lupus activity.

items.titleZh: 病例报告：狼疮中的罕见运动风暴：眼阵挛-肌阵挛-共济失调综合征作为重度系统性红斑狼疮的非典型表现。
items.abstractZh: 眼阵挛-肌阵挛-共济失调综合征（OMAS）是一种罕见的高动力性运动障碍，其特征为眼阵挛、全身性肌阵挛和小脑性共济失调。在成人中，OMAS最常见于副肿瘤性或感染后情况，而自身免疫性病因较少见。一名有7个月系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）病史的21岁女性出现了为期3周的亚急性OMAS表型，表现为眼阵挛、全身性肌阵挛以及步态/肢体共济失调，导致无法独立行走。脑脊液（CSF）、微生物学检测和脑MRI均无异常，初始恶性肿瘤筛查为阴性。记录了重度狼疮活动（SLEDAI-2K 27）。她接受了甲泼尼龙冲击治疗、血浆置换和利妥昔单抗治疗，神经系统逐渐恢复，狼疮活动降至SLEDAI-2K 4。出院时，她能独立行走，仅有轻度残留步态共济失调。本病例通过展示OMAS作为一种主要运动表型，扩展了神经精神性狼疮的谱系。进行结构化评估以排除结构性、感染性和恶性病因至关重要，当OMAS发生在重度狼疮活动背景下时，早期升级免疫治疗可能与显著的神经系统恢复相关。

items.title: Exploring the risk of venous thromboembolism in women with rheumatoid arthritis initiating menopausal hormone treatment in England.
items.abstract: While RA and menopausal hormone treatment (MHT) are known to increase the risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE), how MHT influences VTE incidence within the RA population has not been well-characterised. This study aimed to evaluate whether MHT is associated with an increased risk of VTE in peri- and postmenopausal women with RA. We conducted a retrospective, matched cohort study using UK primary care data from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum, linked to secondary care, from 2001 to 2021. Women ages 40-79 years with RA initiating MHT were matched to women with RA not initiating MHT. VTE incidence rates were calculated and Cox proportional hazards models adjusted for risk factors estimated the MHT-associated VTE risk. A total of 2187 women with RA initiating MHT were matched to 8205 unexposed controls. VTE incidence was higher among MHT users [6.49 (95% CI 4.28, 9.44) per 1000 person-years vs 3.30 (95% CI 2.44, 4.36)]. MHT use was associated with a 92% increased risk of VTE in RA [adjusted hazard ratio (aHR) 1.92 (95% CI 1.19, 3.12)], primarily driven by a higher risk of deep vein thrombosis [DVT; aHR 2.26 (95% CI 1.26, 4.05)]. MHT use in peri- and postmenopausal women with RA is associated with a 2-fold increased risk of VTE, particularly DVT, relative to unexposed controls. Individualised risk assessment and monitoring are advised, taking into account the patient's clinical context. Clinicians should balance MHT benefits against thrombotic risks and consider alternatives or preventive strategies.

items.title: Multivariate analysis of treatment choices, disease activity, comorbidities, and oral impairments in rheumatoid arthritis patients.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic systemic inflammatory disease that affects the synovial joints and is often associated with multiple comorbidities. Emerging evidence suggests a bidirectional link between RA and periodontal inflammation, wherein shared inflammatory mediators contribute to disease severity and therapeutic outcomes. The objective of the study was to examine the relationships among demographic and clinical characteristics, comorbidities, periodontal impairment assessed using Russell's Periodontal Index, systemic disease activity measured by Disease Activity Score (DAS28) and C-reactive protein (CRP), and treatment regimens in patients with RA. A cross-sectional cohort of 33 patients clinically diagnosed with RA (21 seropositive and 12 seronegative) was analyzed. Demographic, serological, and clinical data were retrieved from medical records and verified during follow-up consultations. Russell's Index was used to quantify periodontal involvement, whereas disease activity was assessed using the DAS28 score, which incorporates CRP levels. Details of comorbidities and prescribed treatments, hydroxychloroquine (HCQ), corticosteroids, or combination therapy, were documented. Descriptive and correlational analyses were performed to evaluate associations between disease activity, oral impairment, and therapeutic approach. The cohort comprised 91% females, with a mean age of 46.5 ± 9.8 years. Seropositive RA was identified in 64% of patients. The mean Russell's Index was 2.42 in the RA + and 1.92 in the RA - groups, showing greater periodontal impairment in seropositive cases. Hypertension (12%), diabetes (6%), and hypothyroidism (6%) were the most frequent comorbidities. Combination therapy (HCQ + steroids) was most commonly prescribed (36%) and associated with higher DAS28 and Russell's scores. A positive correlation was noted between disease activity and periodontal index values. Both systemic comorbidities and oral inflammatory burden influence RA severity. Integrating periodontal assessment with systemic disease monitoring enables more precise, personalized therapy selection. Russell's Index, in conjunction with DAS28 and CRP, may serve as a useful adjunctive marker for therapeutic stratification in RA.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎患者治疗选择、疾病活动度、合并症与口腔损伤的多变量分析。
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性系统性炎症性疾病，影响滑膜关节，且常与多种合并症相关。新出现的证据提示RA与牙周炎症之间存在双向关联，其中共享的炎症介质影响疾病严重程度和治疗结局。本研究旨在探讨RA患者的人口学和临床特征、合并症、使用Russell牙周指数评估的牙周损伤、通过疾病活动评分（DAS28）和C反应蛋白（CRP）测量的系统性疾病活动度以及治疗方案之间的关系。分析了一个由33例临床诊断为RA的患者（21例血清阳性和12例血清阴性）组成的横断面队列。人口学、血清学和临床数据从医疗记录中获取，并在随访咨询中核实。使用Russell指数量化牙周受累情况，而疾病活动度通过包含CRP水平的DAS28评分评估。记录了合并症和处方治疗（羟氯喹（HCQ）、皮质类固醇或联合治疗）的详细信息。进行了描述性和相关性分析，以评估疾病活动度、口腔损伤和治疗方案之间的关联。该队列中91%为女性，平均年龄为46.5±9.8岁。64%的患者为血清阳性RA。RA+组的平均Russell指数为2.42，RA-组为1.92，显示血清阳性病例的牙周损伤更严重。高血压（12%）、糖尿病（6%）和甲状腺功能减退（6%）是最常见的合并症。联合治疗（HCQ+类固醇）最常被处方（36%），且与较高的DAS28和Russell评分相关。疾病活动度与牙周指数值之间呈正相关。系统性合并症和口腔炎症负担均影响RA严重程度。将牙周评估与系统性疾病监测相结合，可实现更精确、个体化的治疗选择。Russell指数与DAS28和CRP联合使用，可作为RA治疗分层的有用辅助标志物。

items.title: Rapidly Progressive Intracranial Arterial Stenosis in Giant Cell Arteritis: A Case Report with Longitudinal Imaging and Implications for Endovascular Management.
items.abstract: The natural history of intracranial arterial stenosis caused by giant cell arteritis (GCA) and the effects of therapeutic interventions remain unclear. We report a case of rapidly progressive intracranial arterial stenosis associated with GCA and discuss its clinical course and the implications for endovascular management. A 75-year-old man developed multiple intracranial arterial stenoses and occlusions over several months, resulting in cerebral infarction. Percutaneous transluminal angioplasty was performed for severe stenosis of the cavernous segment of the right internal carotid artery, which exhibited delayed distal contrast opacification. Temporal artery biopsy confirmed the diagnosis of GCA. Although inflammatory markers improved with optimal medical treatment, the untreated intracranial arterial stenoses progressed rapidly, leading to extensive cerebral infarction. In contrast, no restenosis was observed at the site treated with angioplasty during the 6-month follow-up period. Rapidly progressive intracranial involvement in GCA may lead to a devastating clinical course, with progression of arterial stenosis occurring despite apparent control of systemic inflammation. This case highlights that intracranial arterial stenosis due to GCA can progress rapidly even under immunosuppressive therapy, underscoring the importance of serial vascular imaging and suggesting that some patients may benefit from early consideration of endovascular treatment.

items.titleZh: 巨细胞动脉炎中快速进展的颅内动脉狭窄：一例纵向影像学病例报告及对血管内治疗的启示
items.abstractZh: 巨细胞动脉炎（GCA）引起的颅内动脉狭窄的自然病程及治疗干预的效果仍不清楚。我们报告一例与GCA相关的快速进展性颅内动脉狭窄病例，并讨论其临床病程及对血管内治疗的启示。一名75岁男性在数月内出现多处颅内动脉狭窄和闭塞，导致脑梗死。对右颈内动脉海绵窦段严重狭窄进行了经皮腔内血管成形术，该处表现为远端对比剂延迟显影。颞动脉活检确诊为GCA。尽管最佳药物治疗后炎症标志物改善，但未治疗的颅内动脉狭窄快速进展，导致广泛脑梗死。相比之下，血管成形术治疗部位在6个月随访期内未观察到再狭窄。GCA中快速进展的颅内受累可能导致灾难性的临床病程，尽管全身炎症得到明显控制，动脉狭窄仍进展。本病例强调，即使在免疫抑制治疗下，GCA引起的颅内动脉狭窄也可能快速进展，凸显了系列血管影像学检查的重要性，并提示部分患者可能受益于早期考虑血管内治疗。
